程序包 TA_Recruitment_software.mo_publish

类 MOPublishService

java.lang.Object
TA_Recruitment_software.mo_publish.MOPublishService
public class MOPublishService extends Object
Service layer for Module Organizer (MO) job publishing and management operations.

This class provides business logic for publishing, updating, and closing job positions, as well as AI-powered job description generation. All operations require MO or ADMIN role authentication via session token validation.

Key features:

  • Publish new TA positions with validation and semester registration
  • Update position details, deadline, or close positions
  • Auto-close expired positions when listing
  • Generate AI-assisted job descriptions via Alibaba Cloud DashScope API

  • 方法详细资料

    • publishPosition

      public Position publishPosition(String token, String jobTitle, String grade, String major, String jobType, String jobDescription, String requirements, String interviewLocation, String deadline, String semester, int headcount)
      Publishes a new TA position after validating all input fields and checking permissions.

      The position is saved with OPEN status and registered with the specified semester. Only MO and ADMIN roles can publish positions.

      参数:
      token - valid session token for authentication
      jobTitle - the job title (max 200 chars)
      grade - target student grade (e.g., "Year 2", "All Grades")
      major - target major (e.g., "Computer Science", "All majors")
      jobType - job category (e.g., "Grading", "Lab Support")
      jobDescription - detailed job description (max 3000 chars)
      requirements - applicant requirements (max 3000 chars)
      interviewLocation - interview venue location
      deadline - application deadline in "yyyy-MM-dd" format
      semester - academic semester (e.g., "2025-Fall"); uses current semester if empty
      headcount - number of TAs needed (must be positive)
      返回:
      the saved Position entity with generated positionId
      抛出:
      AppException - if permission denied, validation fails, or publisher not found

    • updateDeadline

      public Position updateDeadline(String token, String positionId, String newDeadline)
      Updates the application deadline of an existing position and notifies all applicants.

      Only the position owner (MO) or ADMIN can update the deadline. The new deadline must be today or in the future.

      参数:
      token - valid session token
      positionId - the position to update
      newDeadline - new deadline in "yyyy-MM-dd" format
      返回:
      the updated Position entity
      抛出:
      AppException - if permission denied, position not found, or date validation fails

    • updatePositionDetails

      public Position updatePositionDetails(String token, String positionId, String jobTitle, String grade, String major, String jobType, String jobDescription, String requirements, String interviewLocation, String deadline, int headcount)
      Updates multiple fields of an existing position and notifies applicants of changes.

      Tracks which fields changed to build a human-readable summary for notifications. Only the position owner (MO) or ADMIN can update the position.

      参数:
      token - valid session token
      positionId - the position to update
      jobTitle - new job title
      grade - new target grade
      major - new target major
      jobType - new job category
      jobDescription - new job description
      requirements - new applicant requirements
      interviewLocation - new interview location
      deadline - new deadline
      headcount - new headcount
      返回:
      the updated Position entity
      抛出:
      AppException - if permission denied, position not found, or validation fails

    • closePosition

      public Position closePosition(String token, String positionId)
      Closes a position, making it no longer accept new applications.

      Notifies all applicants with pending/shortlisted/interviewed/offered status that the position has been closed. Only the position owner (MO) or ADMIN can close positions.

      参数:
      token - valid session token
      positionId - the position to close
      返回:
      the closed Position entity
      抛出:
      AppException - if permission denied or position not found

    • listMyPositions

      public List<Position> listMyPositions(String token)
      Lists all positions owned by the current MO, or all positions if ADMIN.

      Automatically checks and updates expired positions (deadline passed) to EXPIRED status.

      参数:

      返回:
      list of positions accessible to the current user
      抛出:

    • generateAITemplate

      public Map<String,String> generateAITemplate(String grade, String major, String jobType, String courseName) throws Exception
      Generates a job description template using Alibaba Cloud DashScope AI API.
